reference_inventory_status: All 31 numbered references transcribed from PDF pp. 3:9-3:11, 27 with printed DOIs and four without. Each is citation-only/unchecked within this isolated audit; reconcile against the canonical citation ledger before changing global checked states. Body p. 3:3 cites the Iqbal-and-Bailey alert definition as [17], but [17] is Iqbal and Horvitz whereas [16] is Iqbal and Bailey.
minimum_typed_inputs: participant-scoped NotificationListener posted callbacks with occurrence time, title, originating app/package, and an exact identity linking any later removal callback
participant-scoped NotificationListener removed callbacks with occurrence time and removal identity; removal reason remains unknown unless source actually recorded it
participant-scoped screen on/off/unlock broadcasts and Accessibility app-launch/drawer-access events with source-preserved timestamps and ordering
foreground-app state at notification arrival, plus original pending-set state at participant observation start or an explicit censoring rule
source-version translation list, 2016 package/category map, excluded-app list, and exact WhatsApp title-pattern implementation
participant-specific observation windows and day-denominator semantics

configuration_verdicts.reason: The published PDF supports a detailed specification but the verified raw dataset, collector/build/schema, source scripts, exact burst and category artifacts, and full transition/statistical oracles are unavailable; method-target vocabulary exists, but a populated typed callback/perceived-alert/attendance instance and its actual import path have not yet been proven.

required_execution_proofs: A source-shaped fixture must distinguish multiple posted callbacks representing one alert from separate alerts; title-translation removal precedes same-second keep-last reduction.

Boundary cases must establish exactly-equal timestamps, adjacent timestamps on opposite second boundaries, multiple apps/participants, update/repost matching, and missing removal callbacks; unresolved source choices remain blocked rather than guessed.

An alert state fixture must separately test pending-at-unlock, already-unlocked arrival, drawer open, app open before/after removal, app already foreground, and removal after consumption; removal must never imply user dismissal.
An analysis fixture must keep immediate-foreground Table 5 reporting apart from conversion classification and apply 2/5/10/30-minute flow snapshots only to the non-immediate population.
Any new ontology element needs a negative necessity test, import/persistence/export round-trip, and non-regression proof before profile promotion.

projection_integrity.round_trip: 38 normalized method definitions pass parser and IndexedDB save/reload; populated typed notification instances and GUI import are not tested

next_action: Independent source-to-atom review, verify any genuine ACM supplementary dataset/scripts, then compare with Annotif and My Phone and Me before proposing a single typed notification callback/alert/attendance extension. Do not merge this candidate or mark a paper profile runnable until exact source identities, fixture semantics, and lossless round-trip are proven.
